title: Queue Using Stacks
statement:
Implement a Queue using at most two Stacks. You must process Q queries:
- `1 X` : Push X into the queue.
- `2` : Pop the front element of the queue.
- `3` : Print the front element of the queue.

You can assume queries of type 2 and 3 will always be valid (the queue won't be empty). Implement the queue logic entirely using Stacks.
constraints:
1 <= Q <= 10^5
-10^9 <= X <= 10^9
Queue will not be empty when Pop or Front is queried.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer Q.
Next Q lines: queries as described above.
outputFormat: For every type 3 query, print the front element on a new line.

examples.explanation: Push 5, Push 10. Front is 5 (print). Pop 5. Front is 10 (print). Pop 10.
